blocks.text: Hydrogen ions ki maujoodgi mein hydrogen peroxide iodide ions se react kar ke pani aur iodine banata hai: H2O2(aq) + 2I-(aq) + 2H+(aq) se 2H2O(l) + I2(aq), rate muadla rate = k [H2O2][I-] ke saath. Reaction iodine banne ki initial rate naap kar follow ki jati hai, aur Table 7.2 mukhtalif initial concentrations ke liye rates deti hai. Experiment 1 istemal karte hue: rate muadla likhein, rate = k [H2O2][I-]; k ke liye tarteeb badlein, k = rate / ([H2O2][I-]); qeematein rakhein, k = 3.50 x 10^-6 / (0.0200 x 0.0100) = 1.75 x 10^-2 dm3 mol-1 s-1. Hydrogen ions ki concentration nazar-andaz ki jati hai kyunke [H+] rate muadle mein nahi aata: reaction H+ ke lihaz se zero order hai.

blocks.caption: Initial rate par concentration ka asar (Table 7.2)

blocks.prompt: 2HI se H2 + I2 par teen experiments ne [HI] = 0.015, 0.030 aur 0.045 mol dm-3 par 1.1 x 10^-3, 4.4 x 10^-3 aur 9.9 x 10^-3 mol dm-3 s-1 ki rates din. Rate law likhein aur k apni units ke saath nikalein.
blocks.explanation: [HI] dugna karne (0.015 se 0.030) se rate 4 se aur tigna karne se 9 se zarb hoti hai, to rate [HI]^2 ke mutanasib hai: rate = k [HI]^2, doosra order. k = 1.1 x 10^-3 / (0.015)^2 = 1.1 x 10^-3 / 2.25 x 10^-4 = 4.9 dm3 mol-1 s-1.

items: Initial rates: rate = k [H2O2][I-]; k = rate / ([H2O2][I-]) = 3.50 x 10^-6 / (0.0200 x 0.0100) = 1.75 x 10^-2 dm3 mol-1 s-1; [H+] zero order hai aur nazar-andaz.
